name: Barbell Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench with both feet planted and grasp the bar at about shoulder width.
Set your shoulder blades against the bench, brace your trunk and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest while keeping your elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press the bar straight back up until your elbows are fully extended.
tips: Choose a grip width that keeps your wrists stacked comfortably over your forearms.
Avoid gripping so narrowly that your wrists twist inward or elbows flare out.
